preservations.reason: Whole-root rename received EPERM. Its exact data partition was archived using independent verified child moves; the original container is preserved.
Delivery directory rename received EPERM. Its nine immediate children were later moved and verified; the empty original directory remains.
Historical run lacks validated nonce ownership. Retained in place without content traversal.

validation.scope: Pinned original public archiver fully hashes/inventories before/latest/after each move. Independent review rehashes operation records, inspects terminal metadata, reconstructs exact original child subsets, and checks source/destination root identities. It does not independently traverse all archived content.

history.qualification: Archive overlapped Commit A. The108 resume and two explicit levels of child moves occurred later. Initial and later EPERM attempts remain recorded. No claim is made that cleanup finished before Commit A, that either preserved container was moved or removed, or that MAX_PATH/AV/CWD caused EPERM.

evidence.method: Stream SHA256 exact main and before per194 verified moves; bounded terminal ID/count/inventory hash; exact reconstruction of9731 original files and all moved child directory identities; lstat/one-level checks only for protected/preserved roots. No raw evidence contents, credential or profile data are published.

limitations: Original implementation container and its empty delivery child remain intentionally present, together with the historical unowned run.
Directory identities do not certify protected descendant contents; profiles, drafts, configs and credentials were not inspected.
The independent reviewer did not perform a second traversal/hash of613966 archived content files; the original archiver did before/latest/after verification at movement time.
The external namespaced variant passed six unit tests and failed its real whole-root attempt. It is not reported as the successful solution.
The cause of the whole-root and delivery rename EPERM remains unproven; verified moves of all classified file data resolved the archival objective without deletion or terminating processes.
